moods.mood_description: The Buddha teaches the path to all beings
Whether the teaching will take root and spread
The Buddha's compassion for the suffering of all beings
Caste, station, and the world's resistance to the teaching
The quiet struggle to carry the light into the world
The world believes awakening is for the few; the Buddha teaches it is for all
Kings and outcasts alike sit at the Buddha's feet
The sangha forms, and the teaching spreads
The final teaching and the echo to come
The man who renounced everything becomes the refuge of the world
